title: Basic Foundation and Fixed GUI [BFFGUI]
description: A template mudpack for vanilla use or Template for your modded adventures
body:
BFFGUI – Basic Foundation and Fixed GUI

BFFGUI (Basic Foundation and Fixed GUI) is a carefully built modpack designed for quick play, smooth performance, and a stable base for expanded modded adventures. It focuses on optimization, visual enhancement, and interface improvement, making it ideal for both minimal vanilla-style gameplay and as a foundation for adding larger mods. The pack ensures a fixed, consistent GUI experience while keeping the core Minecraft feel intact.


<details>
<summary>Included mods:</summary>

AppleSkin, BadOptimizations, BetterStats, Bookshelf, c2me-fabric, Cloth Config, Clumps, Collective, Enchantment Descriptions, EntityCulling, Fabric API, Fabric Language Kotlin, FerriteCore, ImmediatelyFast, Indium, Inventory Profiles Next, Iris, LambDynamicLights, LazyDFU, libIPN, Lithium, malilib, MemoryLeakFix, Mod Menu, MoreCulling, MouseTweaks, NoChatReports, Reese’s Sodium Options, SkinLayers3D, Sodium, Sodium Extra, TCD Commons, YetAnotherConfigLib, and Zoomify.

</details>



Each component contributes to a stable and enhanced experience. Performance mods like Sodium, Lithium, and FerriteCore boost frame rates. Iris and LambDynamicLights improve visuals. Inventory Profiles Next, MouseTweaks, and BetterStats refine usability. Configuration and compatibility are streamlined through Cloth Config, Mod Menu, and YACL.

Altogether, BFFGUI provides a balanced, optimized, and visually consistent environment ready for instant play or as a modular foundation for building your ultimate adventure.
